context.transcript:
As you know, the company is preparing to launch a new line of luxury sedans.
The advertising campaign is substantial.
You can see here in the table on the screen that we have been working in stages to create the content for the advertisements, and So-hyun's team has already created some excellent content for broadcast media.
Now we need to focus on internet ads, which will have the widest reach.
We have plenty of experience with internet ads after launching the new light truck last year.
Please use your experience with these ads to create new advertising content for the new sedans.
Everyone should develop a sample ad by the end of the week.
context.transcript_translation:
如各位所知，公司正准备推出一个新的豪华轿车系列。
这次广告宣传的规模很大。
从屏幕上的这张表格可以看到，我们一直在分阶段制作广告内容，而 So-hyun 的团队已经为广播电视媒体制作了一些出色的内容。
现在我们需要把重点放在网络广告上，因为它们能覆盖最广泛的受众。
去年推出新款轻型卡车时，我们积累了丰富的网络广告经验。
请运用你们制作这些广告的经验，为新的轿车系列创作新的广告内容。
每个人都应在本周结束前制作一份广告样稿。

notes: Employee name spelling is phonetic (ASR: so Hune); printed source can confirm orthography.
